title: Bechinat Olam

description: 14th-century poem about the unpredictable nature of the world and the paths that lead to the world to come. Complete Musar text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Musar is Jewish ethical and devotional literature concerned with character, discipline and the conduct of ordinary life. Its genre ranges from short letters to systematic treatises.
